_comment: Copy to machine.json and fill in. machine.json is gitignored and holds EVERY machine-specific value in this repo. No absolute path belongs anywhere else in the codebase. These are not secrets - secrets live in environment variables and are inventoried in docs/SECRETS.md.
_comment_db: Must be on a local fixed disk. NEVER inside a Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive folder - sync clients copy .db, -wal and -shm independently and corrupt WAL databases.
_comment_backup: Staging MUST be on the same volume as backup_dir so the final step is an atomic rename, not a cross-volume copy a sync client can watch grow. Only encrypted archives enter these folders.
_comment_docs: The nightly job copies docs/*.md here so any chat session can read current state without a manual export.
_comment_claude: Resolved from PATH by default. Set an absolute path only if the S4U task cannot resolve it - see the Phase 0 discovery item on whether claude -p works under S4U at all.
